gloss: to serve; to volunteer; to dedicate oneself

definitions.gloss: to serve; to dedicate oneself to
definitions.explanation: To devote oneself to serving others, a community, or a cause, often selflessly.

definitions.gloss: to sell at a discount; to offer a bargain
definitions.explanation: In a commercial context, to sell goods at a special low price as a service to customers.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}に{奉仕|ほうし}する。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}ボランティアとして{地域|ちいき}に{奉仕|ほうし}してきた。
examples.english: She has served the community as a volunteer for many years.

examples.japanese: {国|くに}に{奉仕|ほうし}する{精神|せいしん}を{持|も}って、{公務員|こうむいん}としての{仕事|しごと}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: I approach my work as a civil servant with a spirit of service to the country.

examples.japanese: {特別|とくべつ}{価格|かかく}で{奉仕|ほうし}します。
examples.english: We offer it at a special price.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}{大|おお}{奉仕|ほうし}セール{開催中|かいさいちゅう}です。
examples.english: Our year-end bargain sale is now in progress.

examples.japanese: お{客様|きゃくさま}に{良|よ}い{品物|しなもの}を{安|やす}く{奉仕|ほうし}するのが、この{店|みせ}の{方針|ほうしん}です。
examples.english: This store's policy is to offer customers good products at low prices.

notes:
Has a sense of selfless dedication. In sense 1, it implies serving a greater good — community, nation, or cause. In sense 2, it is used in retail to suggest that low prices are a form of service to customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}{奉仕|ほうし}: community service
- {奉仕|ほうし}{活動|かつどう}: volunteer activities
- {奉仕|ほうし}{精神|せいしん}: spirit of service
- {奉仕|ほうし}{品|ひん}: bargain item
- {大|おお}{奉仕|ほうし}: big sale, great bargain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仕|つか}える: to serve (a master) — implies a hierarchical relationship
- ボランティアする: to volunteer — casual, modern equivalent for sense 1
- {貢献|こうけん}する: to contribute — focuses on the result rather than the act of serving
